title: What happens to Wednesday's talks and speakers?
summary: Web Summit called off Day 2 (its page, 19:09 on 10 Nov) and said only that it "will communicate directly with those impacted". Whether Wednesday's talks are cancelled, moved to Thursday or put online has not been published anywhere we can read.
closes: A Web Summit page (or its official account) that says what happens to Day 2's programme. A press report or one speaker's post is evidence and moves nothing here.
